scope: Core Scientific consolidated colocation customer relationships, with current revenue, executed customer IT capacity and billing progress kept as separate denominators.

current_revenue.denominator: Current Core Scientific colocation revenue, not total group revenue or future contracted capacity
current_revenue.source_section: MD&A, Strategic Transition to High-Density Colocation Services, page 34

contracted_capacity.unit: MW of leased customer / critical IT capacity

categories.legal_obligor_note: Certain agreements were assigned to CW SPV, an indirect CoreWeave subsidiary; CoreWeave remains a primary obligor.

categories.instrument: Direct leases with Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
Neocloud leases with lease-specific conditional AMD credit support

contracted_capacity.rounding_note: 377 + 152 = 529 MW; management presents the combined agreement as approximately 530 MW. The reported group aggregates sum to approximately 1,120 MW. All capacity figures are approximate.

billing_progress.rounding_note: Use the reported aggregate billing total. The deck states that approximate site figures may not add due to rounding. Billable capacity is not a cash-collection percentage.

new_lease_delivery.lease_commencement_condition: Completion of contracted capacity and satisfaction of applicable commencement conditions
new_lease_delivery.funding_note: Q3 10-Q describes additional financing needs for the AMD and Neocloud build-out and expected project-level bond financing; delivery forecasts are not funded revenue guarantees.

elements: Protection for AMD equipment held on the applicable leased premises
AMD right, but not obligation, to cure specified Neocloud defaults
AMD rights and obligations upon specified material Neocloud defaults
amd_credit_support.termination_scope: Applicable lease expiry, specified insolvency/default circumstances, contractual term limit and specified Core Scientific representation-breach provisions
amd_credit_support.scope_warning: Not an unconditional guarantee of all 530 MW, every Neocloud obligation, or the Core Scientific group.

coreweave_share_of_reported_rounded_cont.unit: fraction of reported contracted IT MW

coreweave_share_of_disaggregated_contrac.unit: fraction of disaggregated contracted IT MW

coreweave_billable_share.unit: fraction of CoreWeave contracted IT MW

interpretation.zh: 签约容量已引入AMD与另一客户，但当前托管收入仍全部来自CoreWeave。新增租约尚待建设、融资及交付，不能把未来容量的约53%占比用于当前收入或利润下修。
interpretation.en: Contracted capacity includes AMD and another customer, while current colocation revenue remains entirely dependent on CoreWeave. New leases still require construction, financing and delivery. The roughly 53% future contracted-capacity share is not a current revenue or earnings sensitivity.

guardrails: Current revenue, contracted MW and billing MW use separate denominators and dates.
No same-axis comparison between revenue percentages and MW capacity.
No 1,925 MW reservation right included in contracted totals.
No implied revenue haircut, profit weight, guarantee-coverage ratio or calibrated shock elasticity.
No claim that all 530 MW are directly leased or unconditionally guaranteed by AMD.
This company-level extension does not modify or rerun frozen global model 4.1.
